description: D2: bump the tokscale pin weekly. Only the pin is managed here; other dependencies are updated by hand.

customManagers.description: The tokscale-core git tag, burn-events' crate version and TOKSCALE_PIN move in lockstep (Renovate's cargo manager skips git dependencies).

prBodyNotes: Before merging: run `cargo update -p tokscale-core` in `crates/burn-events` (Renovate does not update the lockfile for git dependencies) and `cargo install --path crates/burn-events`. Diff the `(client, dedup_key)` sets of the old and new `burn-events` output on a real machine: phones retire changed keys at the next full reconciliation, but only inside re-reported sessions. New source kinds must join `source_fingerprint` (its exhaustive `ScanResult` destructure fails to compile until they do). Then tag `burn-events-v<version>` to publish binaries.
